msg: Hi. We want to complete our PADI open water: we have referrals and e-learning certificates. We would also like a refresher first. How does the 2 day open water referral course cost plus a mini course the day before. 2 persons. Thanks
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. So happy to have you here! I'd love to help you put your plan together. 🌊

That’s a great plan! Since you’ve completed the theory and pool sessions at your local PADI center, the *2-day Open Water Referral Course* is the right option to finish your certification. Please bring your referral paperwork signed by a PADI instructor.

The refresher includes pool practice and one ocean dive. The Referral Course includes four certification dives over two days. You’ll need to stay overnight on the islands during the Referral Course, and accommodation isn’t included.

The Mini Course is a guided experience and does not certify; to get certified, you need the Open Water course (2 days, with an overnight stay on the islands).

The refresher is normally required for certified divers who haven’t dived in more than two years.

To give you the exact price I need to know where you're starting from: would you leave *from Cartagena* or are you already *on the Rosario Islands*? Plans and prices change depending on the departure point. 🌊

msg: Ok. Thanks. We will work out the best days. Do you recommend any hotels on the island convenient for the diving?
reply:
Absolutely! For the most convenient access, I’d recommend *Hotel San Pedro de Majagua* or *Hotel Cocoliso* on Isla Grande—our dive base is at both, and pick-up is direct.

Other nearby hotels with maritime access include *Rosario de Mar, Secreto, Ubuntu, Mulata, Eco Hotel Las Palmeras, and Pao Pao*. Pick-up is included if your hotel has boat access; depending on the hotel, we may meet you at a nearby dock. Accommodation isn’t included in the dive plans, so you’d book directly with the hotel.

If you’re staying on the islands, pick-up and drop-off are at your hotel if it has maritime access.

Would you like me to help you compare the diving options once you’ve chosen your dates?
